item: Every date-extraction path passes the article's own language (R697)
summary: The pooled re-index handed extract_dates the keyword stoplist pick (lang or en), unlike the inline store, collector and ingest precompute, so an untagged article got English numeric order (03/04/2024 as 4 March) only in the pool. All paths now pass article.language; unknown uses language-neutral patterns and the tag records extractor dateextract:no-language. Existing tags stay (the store is additive), so old rows do not converge on a re-index.
